notes: Instructor-led Training now defaults responsibility to each trainee's Department Manager. Whole-site training is therefore automatically split by each person's primary department. Managers/Admins can manually override the responsible manager per assignment, while any authorised Manager/Admin may still deliver the training and the signed-in person who records attendance is retained as the actual instructor. Department Managers can use the Instructor view for their own departments without receiving full Safety Manager access. Includes v2.11.55 Groups and v2.11.54 one-login/cache recovery.
